background: Descriptive web page on low-carbon steelmaking options (biomass, CCS, CCUS, electrolysis, hydrogen, next-level blast furnace) with IEA roadmap quotations; no technology-level energy, cost or capacity figures of its own. What it has: Gas-based DRI 1.43 t CO2/t crude steel vs 2.32 for BF route (worldsteel 2023 calculation); electrolysis projects at TRL about 6-7, batches in kilograms; typical BF about 2.5 Mt iron/yr; innovative routes cost 10-50% more than conventional (IEA); DRI and hot-metal chemistry ranges; IEA hydrogen demand projections. No date printed on the page; year 2026 = access year. Parsed from the text/html part of the mhtml.
